# Juss & Co

Canonical site: https://www.jussco.company/
Licensing: https://www.jussco.company/licensing.html
Licensable public-data manifest: https://www.jussco.company/data/licensable-assets.json
Licensing contact: founder@jussco.company

## Public-use policy

Search indexing, linking, and short attributed reference excerpts are allowed.
AI-model training, fine-tuning, bulk extraction, dataset reuse, generative AI ingestion, reproduction, and derivative or competing use require a separate written commercial license.

Public visibility is not a license grant.

## Safe public sources

- https://www.jussco.company/
- https://www.jussco.company/work.html
- https://www.jussco.company/services.html
- https://www.jussco.company/data/licensable-assets.json

## Never part of the licensing export

Private user or customer records; child, teen, guardian, family, or private-message data; authentication or payment records; credentials; private analytics; internal prompts; safety thresholds; internal receipts; and unreleased architecture.

For the repository license and source-code restrictions, see https://github.com/jussray/jussray/blob/main/LICENSE
